gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (trimmed p5, printed p9) prints Total expenditures 938,667 = General 465,966 + Street 281,139 + Cemetery 9,695 + Community Ambulance 28,942 + Swimming Pool 58,095 + Other Governmental Funds 94,830; the Debt Service Fund expenditure column is blank because the statement prints Debt principal payments (180,000) and Debt interest payments (58,885) under Other Financing Sources (Uses) (p6, printed p10). The Debt Service Fund budget schedule (p16) prints the same money as disbursements, Total disbursements 238,885 (= 180,000 + 58,885), and detail follows the schedule. Detail 1,177,552 = 465,966 + 281,139 + 238,885 + 58,095 + 9,695 + 28,942 + nonmajor (Park 8,248 + Library 3,543 + Fitness Center 944 + Library Board 82,095 = 94,830). 1,177,552 - 938,667 = 238,885 = the Debt Service schedule disbursements shown as other financing on the statement. Nothing missing or duplicated; no fix.

Statement business-type disbursements 631,074 = proprietary modified cash statement Total operating expenditures 592,529 + Debt payments 22,221 + Interest expense 16,324 (p8, printed p12). Water Enterprise Fund schedule (p21) Total disbursements 607,885 (incl. Debt principal payments 22,221 and Interest expense 16,324) is complete in detail. The Sewer Enterprise Fund schedule (p22) prints Total disbursements 23,189 but its printed actual lines are Operating supplies 2,818 + Other supplies 6,582 + Repairs and maintenance 10,352 + Utilities 3,406 = 23,158 (its Payroll taxes and employee benefits actual is blank); the 31 is the Sewer Fund 'Salaries' 31 printed on the proprietary statement (p8). 607,885 + 23,158 + 31 = 631,074 = statement total.
